**Test-Elixir** is a project in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md). Its code is written mainly in [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md) (80.8 %), with [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md) and [CSS](@/glossary/css.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 15 September 2017; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 16 September 2017. It reads “Cosmetics”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2017, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/Test-Elixir) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/Test-Elixir).

Related work in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md): [rustler-test](@/work/rustler-test.md) (2017), [skull-elixir](@/work/skull-elixir.md) (2016), [node-proxy-upload](@/work/node-proxy-upload.md) (2016) and [generator-the-scratch](@/work/generator-the-scratch.md) (2013).
